subjects.name: Dominion Voting Systems v. Fox News Network

summary: A walk through Dominion Voting Systems' 2023 summary-judgment filing against Fox News, showing that Fox hosts and executives privately dismissed the 2020 stolen-election claims about Dominion as false while airing them to win back viewers from Newsmax.
keywords: News of the World phone hacking

evidence.note: Host introduces the Dominion and Smartmatic defamation suits against Fox
Main source named: Dominion's public brief seeking summary judgment
Powell's Dominion vote-flipping claim aired on Bartiromo's show in November 2020
Backlash over the Arizona call and Newsmax competition drive Fox's choices
Murdoch message linking Fox voices to the stolen-election story and January 6
Carlson, Ingraham and Hannity privately fear audience loss and Trump
Powell's anonymous source email with absurd claims shared with Fox hosts
Executives treat Newsmax as a commercial threat to their ratings
Carlson pushes to get a reporter fired for fact-checking a Trump tweet
January 2021 messages and Lindell appearance close the narrative

notes: Format: like the Twitter lawsuit episode, this reads a fresh legal filing about recent events, so current-affairs rather than media-reading. Fox News is the sole primary subject, so roles are empty; Carlson and Murdoch are secondary. The UK phone hacking scandal gets a few minutes as background only and is kept to keywords. covered_span ends in 2023 to include the lawsuit itself.
